overview: The City Council and Community Development Board met to refine the proposed Medford Square zoning updates, focusing on historic preservation, parking flexibility, and development incentives. The bodies issued formal guidance to the project consultant to prepare a revised proposal and a specific development overlay for the March 25 public hearing.

items.title: Meeting Minutes
items.summary: Approved the minutes of the special joint meeting held on January 21, 2026.

items.title: Zoning Meeting Schedule
items.summary: Approved a proposed zoning meeting schedule through May 2026 to provide clarity on consultant deliverables and public feedback deadlines.

items.title: Medford Square Zoning Recap
items.summary: Planning staff presented a recap of proposed Medford Square zoning changes, including shadow studies, daylight minimums, and updates to the use table regarding municipal parking and accessory dwelling units.

items.title: Historic Resource Protection and Adaptive Reuse
items.summary: CDB Chair Doug Carr presented strategies for integrating parking into zoning and using incentives to encourage the creative reimagination and preservation of historic buildings in the square.

items.title: Historic District Establishment Process
items.summary: The Community Preservation Manager provided an overview of the 12-to-24-month legal process required to implement a local historic district.

items.title: Public Hearing and Correspondence
items.summary: The bodies read a letter from the Chamber of Commerce and heard public testimony regarding the trade-offs between parking mandates and walkability, as well as the importance of arts integration and historic incentives.

items.title: Guidance to Zoning Consultant
items.summary: Approved a joint motion directing Innis Associates to prepare a revised proposal including flexible parking options, historic preservation overlays, arts incentives, and refined dimensional requirements.

items.title: Transom Project Overlay Discussion
items.summary: Planning staff recommended a specific zoning overlay for the Transom development parcels to provide the time certainty necessary for the planned grocery store and senior center parking solution.

items.title: Continuation and Adjournment
items.summary: Voted to continue the public hearing on Medford Square zoning to March 25, 2026, and adjourned the meeting.
